findings.title: W11 pin never asserts the drops land ON the shared uplink bundle — the host's wide drop (pipe 12) is an unexcluded drop site
findings.evidence:
testing.expectf(t, drops > 0, "the shared uplink must congest (the aggregation choke is real), got 0 drops")
	testing.expectf(t, narrow_drops == 0, ...)
findings.detail: The card's hard req 3: 'an aggregation scenario where the SHARED link (not the access drop) congests.' The pin excludes only the 12 narrow bundles; drops>0 is global, so a shed entirely at the host's wide drop (pipe 12) would satisfy it. PR body documents the measured 293/293 at the shared bundle but the test doesn't pin it.
findings.recommended_fix: Resolve the shared uplink's bundle (pipe 13) after the run and assert by_bundle[shared_bundle] > 0 (or == drops, per the PR's own 293/293 measurement).
